bullets.text: Pixel 10 Pro Fold: Durability Wins - **Google**'s latest foldable prioritizes durability and battery life over sleek design.
Pixel Buds 2A: Budget-Friendly Sound - **Google**'s Pixel Buds 2A offer strong sound quality at a lower price point.
Emergency SOS Expansion - **Apple**'s Emergency SOS via satellite feature will launch in Mexico later this year.
Pixel Watch 4: Stunning Display - The **Google** Pixel Watch 4 features a unique domed display for enhanced visibility.
Prime Day Deals Still Live - Great discounts on tech gadgets remain available as **Amazon**'s Prime Day event winds down.
OpenAI's Global Expansion - **OpenAI** expands its affordable ChatGPT Go plan to 16 new countries in Asia.
Accessibility Compliance Boost - **DevAlly** raises €2M to help businesses comply with Europe's new accessibility law.
TestFlight Update: New Features - **Apple**'s TestFlight introduces a refreshed look and accessibility improvements.
